title: Torsion of a tube through a kinematically coupled reference point
source: Saint-Venant torsion of a circular tube, φ = TL/(GJ), τ = Tr/J with J = π(b⁴ − a⁴)/2; Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., 1970, §104

quantities.quantity: rotation of the reference point about z
quantities.reason: Saint-Venant torsion of a circular tube is exact in elasticity; the rigid end coupling only stiffens a short zone near the tip; quadratic elements with 16 divisions around are within 0.1%

quantities.quantity: surface shear stress τ_θz = σ_yz at (10, 0, 20)
quantities.reason: stress extrapolated to the outer surface and averaged where two blocks meet: about 0.3% with four radial quadratic elements (two gave 1.1%)
